jobs.title: Risk Officer

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description of the role

For our headquarters in Lugano we are looking for a risk officer with at least 5 years of experience, with developed expertise in the fields of risk monitoring for asset management and risk management activities ICT, Cyber and BCM. The resource will be part of the Bank's Risk Office team, contributing to the management, monitoring and reporting of all other major business risks, with particular focus on operational risk and second-level control processes. The candidate will cooperate with the various functions of the Bank and the Group, supporting the identification of risks, the definition of mitigation measures and the continuous improvement of the risk management system. We are looking for a figure capable of combining normative rigor and pragmatic vision, helping to build an effective balance between risk control and support for the other functions of the Bank.

Tasks and responsibilities

• For activities of the Risk Office function, independently monitor and evaluate the risk management generated by the Bank's operational activities, ensuring an adequate identification, analysis, measurement and evaluation of the management of potential risk events (including those relating to IT, cyber and operational continuity risks);
